Custom.name: Report POST Configuration
Custom.Description:
Configuration for the "Report Result POST" rule.
targetUrl - full URL of the receiving endpoint, e.g. https://reports.example.com/api/ingest bearerToken - shared secret sent as "Authorization: Bearer ...". Store it IIQ-encrypted: run "iiq encrypt <secret>" and paste the encrypted value here. reportName - name of the report TaskDefinition; used only when the rule runs standalone (not as a completion rule). connectTimeoutMs - HTTP connect timeout in milliseconds. readTimeoutMs - HTTP read timeout in milliseconds.
